title: The Sheik: A Novel
summary: "The Sheik: A Novel" by E. M. Hull is a novel published in 1919. When independent Englishwoman Diana Mayo ventures alone into the Algerian desert, she is kidnapped by the mysterious Sheik Ahmed Ben Hassan. This controversial bestseller sparked a major revival of desert romance fiction and became the basis for the famous Rudolph Valentino film.
